name: Saxton, Cornwall, UK
description: An invented harbour town that the story puts in the Fens of eastern England but that was built from photographs of Polperro, with Looe, Talland Bay and Duloe around it: the harbour, the beach, Willy Wilcox Cave and the old net store on the cliffs are all real Polperro. Pinned on Polperro harbour, where its streets can be walked.
